items.text: NBC aired the first episode of Saturday Night Live on October 11, 1975, with George Carlin as the first host.
items.question: Do you remember watching Saturday Night Live in its early years, and who stayed up late with you?
items.source_quote: October 11 – NBC airs the first episode of Saturday Night Live (George Carlin is the first host; Billy Preston and Janis Ian the first musical guests).

items.text: Captain & Tennille's "Love Will Keep Us Together" was the longest-running number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1975, with four weeks at the top in June and July.
items.question: Where were you living when Captain & Tennille's "Love Will Keep Us Together" was on the radio that summer, and who sang along with it?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1975, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations respectively. During the year, 35 different singles spent time at number one.
the year's longest-running number one, "Love Will Keep Us Together" by Captain & Tennille, which spent four weeks in the top spot in June and July.

items.text: On October 21, 1975, the Boston Red Sox beat the Cincinnati Reds in Game 6 of the World Series on Carlton Fisk's 12th-inning home run, and the Reds won the series in Game 7 the next day.
items.question: Who in your family watched the 1975 World Series between Boston and Cincinnati, and where did you see Carlton Fisk's home run?
items.source_quote: October 21 – 1975 World Series: US baseball team the Boston Red Sox defeat the Cincinnati Reds in Game 6 off Carlton Fisk's 12th-inning home run in one of the most famous World Series games ever played. The following day, the series ends with Game 7 victory by the Reds

items.text: On July 17, 1975, an American Apollo and a Soviet Soyuz spacecraft docked in orbit, the first such link-up between spacecraft from the two nations.
items.question: Do you remember the Apollo and Soyuz spacecraft meeting in orbit, and where you saw the news?
items.source_quote: July 17 – Apollo–Soyuz Test Project: An American Apollo and Soviet Soyuz spacecraft dock in orbit, marking the first such link-up between spacecraft from the two nations.
